song.title: Amazing Grace (fixture)
song.author: John Newton
song.notes: Minimal public-domain smoke fixture — not a real Quelea pack song.

section.title: Verse 1
section.lyrics: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound That saved a wretch like me.

section.title: Verse 2
section.lyrics: I once was lost, but now am found Was blind, but now I see.
